title: Saber stable-swap pools (dead DEX) — fake-LP class and arbitrary-CPI surface closed; $0 E-U
closed_reasons: Withdraw validates pool_mint == swap.pool_mint (SwapError::IncorrectMint) — fake LP mints rejected (proven on deployed bytecode, CI test T1)
Vaults are bound to stored reserves; vault owner == PDA(swap, nonce) for all 172 pools; crafted SwapInfo cannot redirect real vaults (test T3)

Unvalidated token_program CPI target is doubly closed: the SPL-Token instruction builders call check_program_account() and return IncorrectProgramId for any id != Tokenkeg before any CPI (proven on the deployed bytecode, test T2 — attacker program never invoked); additionally the runtime requires the CPI callee to be in the caller's account list (agave program-runtime/src/cpi.rs + invoke_context.rs verify_instruction_accounts)
All admin instructions require the admin key signature and cannot move funds (pause/fees/admin rotation only)
Rounding leak from the pre-2022-02-25 deployed code is <=1 raw unit per swap, economically nil vs 5000-lamport tx fees (test T4)

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Saber: fake LP mints are rejected by the deployed program, and the unvalidated token_program CPI target cannot reach SPL Token because the runtime forbids CPI to a program not in the caller's account list; $7.43M (sCASH-excluded) is LP-holder-withdrawable (H-O) under a multisig-upgradeable program (P).
